description: Purchase a 24h Oracle Watch monitored window for one asset (optionally scoped to one chain): ONE product price covers continuous halt/proceed manipulation-signal coverage, then poll the current signal inside the window at no per-call charge via oracle_watch_window_poll (budget: 300 polls, minimum 30s apart). This tool charges the full window product price once — it does not itself issue a signal. The response includes a one-time window token shown exactly once; keep it, every in-window call authenticates with it.

symbol.description: Asset monitored for the whole coverage, e.g. ETH
